name: GPU Voxelization with Atomic Accumulation
aliases: Voxelization via Fragment Shader with Image Atomic Operations
definition: A fragment-shader-based voxelization technique that accumulates per-fragment lighting and material properties into a 3D texture using hardware atomic operations to resolve race conditions and compute a moving average of samples per voxel.
summary: GPU Voxelization with Atomic Accumulation is a fragment-shader technique that uses hardware atomics to compute a moving average of per-fragment data, preventing flickering when multiple primitives overwrite the same voxel.
